environment.description: Quarkus 3.2 serverless handler deployed on AWS Lambda behind API Gateway (HTTP API type, no additional route-level configuration). PostgreSQL 14 via pgBouncer 1.19 in transaction pooling mode with prepared statement support (prepared_statement_mode=server). The oauth_clients table contains a row with client_id='app-client-id' and allowed_redirect_pattern='https://app.example.com/'. No additional request filtering or URL validation middleware is configured on the API Gateway.
